notes: Stateful line-oriented protocol with a 3-state machine (EMPTY/OPEN/CLOSED). The agent must implement a general interpreter that generalizes to fresh command streams; hidden cases probe many edge cases (commands before open and after close, reopen rejection, overwrite, missing keys, malformed/unknown commands, empty LIST, blank lines), so adversarial-input handling and rule generalization carry the difficulty. Single python file, no external deps.
